_comment: Verified Workday tenant slugs, SmartRecruiters company slugs, and iCIMS hosts. Add or remove entries to bias non-tech industry coverage. Each value is a human-readable name; the keys are the URL-slugs the ATS plugins iterate. Slug-harvest (lib/slug-harvest.js) will grow data/companies/index.json with newly-discovered tenants automatically — this file is just the starting set.
